title: Staff access
description: Assign portal roles to Noatum staff. A role is a fixed set of permissions, and a person receives the combination of every role they hold.
navNote: Dimmed areas are not released yet. Your access to them is already set here.
page_organisations: The CargoWise organisation directory the portal mirrors. Read-only: organisations are owned by the source system and linked to customers from here.
orgSourceBranchHint: A CargoWise attribute, not the Noatum office
orgControllingCustomerHint: Shown as evidence; grants no access
orgProvisionalNotice: Typed by hand and not yet confirmed by a source run, so it cannot be linked to a customer.
orgAddressesNote: Addresses belong to the organisation and are never linked to a customer on their own. Address type holds the CargoWise AddressType codes for each address.
orgNotLinkedYet: This organisation is not linked to any customer
page_customers: Customer companies with portal access, their linked organisations and their entitlements.
customerSearch: Search by name or short name
customerCloseWarning: Closing releases this customer's organisation codes so another customer can use them, and disables their users. This cannot be undone.
goLiveNeeds: Not ready to go live. Still needs {{missing}}.
unassignedIntro: Companies CargoWise knows that no customer holds. Each one is a company Noatum trades with that cannot see anything in the portal, so this is the list of who to onboard next. Open an organisation to review it, then link it from the customer you create.
unassignedEmpty: Every confirmed organisation is linked to a customer
inviteHelp: Noatum invites only the first administrator. That person then invites their own colleagues.
inviteOverrideHint: This address is outside the customer's domains. The override is recorded.
inviteIssued: An invitation has been created for {{email}}.
inviteEmailPending: No email transport is configured yet, so nothing has been sent. Copy the link below and pass it on yourself.
inviteLinkHint: Shown once. It expires in 7 days and cannot be retrieved again.
customerCreateHelp: This creates the customer as a draft. It grants nothing until you link an organisation, invite an administrator and set it live.
customerSlugHint: Used in links and reports. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
customerCountryHint: Two-letter country code, such as ES.
customerDomainsCreateHint: Separate several with a comma. Invitations must use one of these.
customerUpdatedHint: Every change to this customer is audited.
customerLifecycleHint: Only a live customer resolves organisation codes.
customerOnboardingNote: A customer goes live once it has a linked organisation and an invited administrator.
customerUsersHint: Each person sees all linked organisations unless restricted.
customerHierarchyHint: A parent sees nothing of its children without an explicit grant.
customerDomainsHint: Invitations must use one of these.
customerServicingHint: Each link can override this with its own office.
customerIdentityHint: Invitations are checked against these domains.
customersIntro: A customer is the company you give portal access to. Each one is linked to the CargoWise organisations it trades under, then its people are invited. Open a customer to see what is still outstanding before it can go live.
organisationsIntro: Every company CargoWise knows: customers, suppliers, carriers, agents and notify parties. The portal mirrors this directory and never edits it, so a wrong name or address is corrected in CargoWise and arrives here on the next import. Confirmed organisations are the ones that can be linked to a customer.
orgImportHelp: The directory is a copy. These runs are how it stays current, and what each one changed.
orgImportAuthoritativeHint: Organisations missing from the file are deactivated. Use only for a full export.
orgImportAdditiveHint: Nothing is deactivated. Safe for a partial file.
orgImportBrakeExplained: The last run declined to deactivate anything because the export carried far fewer organisations than are currently active, or none at all. A truncated export and a genuine removal look the same here. Check the file is complete and run it again.
orgImportDrawerHelp: Reads the organisation export and updates the copy held here. CargoWise is never written to.
orgRolesHint: Role flags as CargoWise records them.
orgLastSeenHint: The last import run that carried this organisation.
orgAddressesHeroHint: Addresses follow the organisation and are never linked on their own.
orgMirrorHint: Read-only mirror. Corrections are made in CargoWise.
customerChecklistHelp: Work down this list. A customer can only go live once it has at least one linked organisation and one invited administrator.
customerLinksHelp: These are the CargoWise organisations this customer may see. Shipments, quotes and invoices reach the portal through these codes, so one company trading as several legal entities is linked to several organisations here. A code can belong to only one customer at a time.
customerAttachHelp: Search the CargoWise directory and pick the organisation this customer trades under. Codes already linked to another customer cannot be chosen.
customerUsersHelp: By default a person sees every organisation linked to their customer. Narrow it when someone should only see one branch or one legal entity.
customerUsersEmpty: No one has been invited yet
userAccessAllHint: Including any organisation linked to this customer later.
userAccessSelectedHint: An organisation linked later will not be visible to this person until you add it here.
userAccessHelp: This controls which of the customer's organisations this person sees across the portal: shipments, quotes, documents and invoices.
userAccessNeedsOne: Choose at least one organisation, or give access to all of them.
orgDetachReason: Detached from the customer detail screen
page_features: Optional capabilities across the portal. Turn one off and it stops immediately for everyone, on the next request.
featureSearch: Search capabilities by name, description or key
featureApprovalHint: The recorded privacy, legal or sponsor approval that permits this.
featureConsequenceOn: This capability becomes available to everyone who holds the matching permission, from the next request.
featureConsequenceOff: This capability stops immediately for everyone, from the next request. Records already created are kept and stay readable.
featureProtectedIntro: These are not switches. They protect tenancy, access and commercial integrity, so there is deliberately no way to turn them off here.
page_settings: Values that can differ by region, branch or customer. The most specific layer wins, and every change is recorded with its reason.
settingScopeHint: Choose a layer to see what it actually gets. A layer that sets nothing inherits from the one above it.
settingInvalidOverride: An override at another layer no longer fits this setting and is being ignored.
settingReasonHint: Recorded in the change log beside the old and new values. Say why this layer differs.
page_pricing: Quote requests waiting to be priced in your branch. Claim one to start; a claim locks it for you and expires if nothing is submitted.
claimBanner: This request is unclaimed. Claim it to start pricing. Claiming locks it for you, the claim expires if nothing is submitted, and an approver can force-release it.
heldByOther: {{name}} is pricing this request. You cannot change it while they hold it.
heldByYou: You are pricing this request. Release it if you are not going to finish.
forceReleaseWarning: {{name}} loses the request and any unsaved pricing they have on screen. This is recorded against your name.
forceReleaseReasonHint: Shown in the audit record. Say why this could not wait.
optionCarrierHint: Carriers for this mode. You can also type one that is not listed.
optionFreeTimeHint: Days before demurrage or detention starts.
optionRecommendLabel: Recommend this option to the customer
optionRecommendHint: Only one option can be recommended. Its figures become the headline on the quote.
optionNotesHint: Shown with this option. Not internal.
costNeverShown: Cost and margin are internal and never shown to the customer.
messageHint: Draft, editable, and sent only when you publish. Saving pricing does not send it.
pricingSaved: Pricing saved. Not yet visible to the customer.
needOneLine: Add at least one charge line with a description before saving.
portalPricingOff: Pricing in the portal is turned off in Feature management. This request is priced in CargoWise; you can still claim it so colleagues know who is handling it.
approvalNeeded: Above {{amount}}, so a second person must approve before this can be published.
previewEmpty: Nothing to preview yet. Add a charge line.
pubModeCw1: This branch submits pricing to CargoWise and publishes after it is confirmed there.
pubModeDirect: This branch publishes directly to the customer without waiting for CargoWise.
costCaptureOn: Cost capture is on for this branch. Cost and margin stay internal.
decisionReady: Ready to go to the customer.
decisionAwaitingYou: Above the approval threshold. You can approve it or send it back.
decisionAwaitingOther: Above the approval threshold. Somebody other than you must approve it.
sendBackTitle: Send this quote back for rework
sendBackWarning: It returns to {{name}} with your reason, and any approval is cleared.
publishWhatCustomer: The customer can see the options and accept one.
publishWhatEmail: They are emailed that a quote is ready. The email carries no prices.
publishWhatCw1: A copy is recorded for CargoWise and sent when the connection is live.
publishWhatDirect: This branch publishes directly, so the customer sees it immediately.
publishReversible: You can re-price afterwards. The customer sees a new version rather than a silent change.
page_unassigned: Records that arrived from the source system without a resolved customer. Correcting the link here makes them visible to the right customer.
page_lookups: Reference lists behind the forms and mappings: multilingual values, parent and child relationships, and where each one applies.
page_branches: Noatum servicing branches and their regional grouping, used for pricing scope and staff assignment.
page_staff: People at Noatum Logistics with portal access.
pagePending: This screen is still being designed
pagePendingDescription: Access to this area is already defined by your role. The screen itself arrives in a later stage, so nothing is shown here yet.
lookupSearchCategories: Filter lists by name, code or origin
lookupNewTypeHint: Adds a top-level list such as Service level, Commodity group or Package type.
lookupValueHint: Adds or edits one selectable option inside the selected lookup type.
lookupOwnerHint: Derived from the list, not set per value.
lookupTypeDescriptionEsHint: A list name is not translated yet.
lookupMetadataHint: Reference only. Nothing in the platform reads this field.
lookupParentRuleHint: Which list a value's parent must come from. Choose self-nesting for a tree.
lookupCodeHint: Lower case letters, digits and underscores. Permanent once saved.
lookupValueCodeHint: The stable identifier. Permanent once saved.
lookupCodeLocked: A code is an identity and cannot be changed.
lookupNoValues: This type has no values yet
lookupCustomerVisibleHint: Off keeps the value out of every customer screen, export and API.
lookupSourceNotice: Values here are owned by {{owner}}. You can approve them for customers and reorder them; their codes and wording come from the source.
lookupSourceRetirableNotice: Values here are owned by {{owner}}. You can retire them, approve them for customers and reorder them; their codes and wording come from the source.
lookupRetireLocked: This list mirrors an application setting, so its values cannot be retired.
lookupLockedNotice: This value is owned elsewhere, so its wording, parent and status are read-only. Customer visibility and sort order remain your decision.
lookupLockedRetirableNotice: This value is owned elsewhere, so its wording and parent are read-only. Whether it is active, visible to customers and its sort order remain your decision.
branchSearch: Filter branches by code, office or region
rolesNote: changes apply on their next request, without signing in again, and are recorded in the audit log
branchHint: Pricing work is limited to the assigned branch.
branchRequired: Assign a branch before granting a pricing role.
desc_platform_admin: Platform governance, staff roles and configuration. Does not grant customer commercial or cost data.
desc_customer_success: Customer onboarding, organisation linking, invitations, support and news.
desc_pricing: Prices quotation requests in the assigned branch.
desc_pricing_approver: Approves priced offers and can release another user's claim.
desc_ops: Authorised read access to shipments, documents and quotes across customers.
search: Filter staff by name or email
trackSearchPlaceholder: Track and trace shipment, container, HBL or PO number
presetDescription: Each preset is a fixed set of permissions. A person may hold several, and receives the combination of them.
presetsEmpty: No assignable role presets are available
reasonHint: Recorded in the audit trail against your name.
actionFailed: That did not go through. Try again, or check whether someone else has already changed it.
userActionHelp_password-reset: We will email {{name}} a single-use link to choose a new password. Their current password keeps working until they use it.
userActionHelp_block: {{name}} will be signed out everywhere and will not be able to sign in. Any unused link is cancelled.
userActionHelp_restore: {{name}} will be able to sign in again with their existing password.
userActionHelp_mfa-reset: Use this when {{name}} has lost their phone. Their second factor and recovery codes are removed, and they set one up again at the next sign-in.
userActionDone_password-reset: A reset link has been issued for {{email}}.
userActionDone_mfa-reset: The second factor for {{email}} has been cleared.
invitationActionHelp_resend: A fresh link goes to {{email}} and the previous one stops working.
invitationActionHelp_revoke: The invitation to {{email}} is withdrawn and its link stops working. You can invite them again later.
invitationActionDone_resend: A new link has been issued for {{email}}.
invitationActionDone_revoke: The invitation to {{email}} has been withdrawn.
validation: Select valid roles and enter a reason of 1 to 400 characters.
conflict: The record changed or an administrator protection blocked this change. Close and reload before editing again.
selfProtection: Your own staff administration access cannot be removed here.
opIntro: Regions and branches are Noatum's own operating structure, kept here by hand. Import and API discovery follow as additive, non-destructive options.
opIntro2: A branch is a Noatum office and scopes the pricing queue. A region groups branches and can span more than one country. CargoWise has no region, so that grouping is ours.
opRegionSearchHint: Filter regions by code or name
opBranchSearchHint: Filter branches by code, office or city
opSourceBranchHint: Optional mapping to the CargoWise ControllingBranch. Never invented, never written back.
opRegionFormHint: A region only groups branches. Its code cannot change once created.
opBranchFormHint: A branch is a Noatum office. Its code cannot change once created.
opRegionsEmpty: No regions match. Add the first one.
opErrCodeTaken: That code is already in use.
opErrInUse: This branch still has staff assigned or customers serviced, so it cannot be deactivated.
opErrStale: This record changed while you were editing. Reload and try again.
cwIntro: These are the ControllingBranch codes CargoWise already sends on your organisations. Map one by creating a portal branch from it, prefilled with the code.
cwEmpty: No CargoWise branch codes have arrived yet. Run an organisation import first.
createIntro: This creates the customer record only. It starts as a draft, so nothing is visible to anyone outside Noatum until you take it live.
createNameHint: The name staff and customers will see.
createLegalNameHint: The legal entity name, when it differs from the name above.
createDomainsHint: Separate several with a comma. Invitations are checked against these; leave it empty to allow any address.
createDefaultsNote: Both can be changed later, and each linked organisation can override the office with its own.
createNextOrganisation: Link at least one CargoWise organisation.
createNextGoLive: Take the customer live once both are done.
linkServicingHint: The Noatum office that looks after this organisation. Leave it on the customer default unless this one differs.
orgLinkCoversHint: Linking is always the whole organisation. Addresses are never linked one by one, so a new address is covered automatically.
orgLinkServicingInherited: Follows the customer default; this link names no office of its own.
reqHint: What the customer submitted, beyond the lane and the cargo above.
checksHint: What is still missing, and what would only be better.
checksAllDone: Everything checked. This is ready to send.
checksBlocked_one: {{count}} thing has to be settled before this can be sent.
checksBlocked_other: {{count}} things have to be settled before this can be sent.
checksAdvisory_one: {{count}} suggestion. You can send without it.
checksAdvisory_other: {{count}} suggestions. You can send without them.

check_validity: Every option says how long it holds, and that date has not passed.
check_saved: The prices on screen have been saved.
check_approval: Approved, where the amount calls for it.
check_recommended: One option is marked as the one we recommend.
check_transit: Transit time given, so the customer can compare on more than price.
check_carrier: Carrier named, since this customer is told who carries it.
check_message: A covering message to the customer.

aiOfferAnother: Would you like a {{ordinal}} option as well?
aiAskScaffold: Set the charges up for this lane.

aiProvenancePricing: Drafted by the assistant — check every figure.

decisionBlocked_other: {{count}} checks still have to be settled before this can be sent.

insert_recommend: We recommend the option marked, which we consider the best balance of transit time and cost for this cargo.
insert_confirm: Please confirm before the validity date so we can secure the space.
heroLede: Price this request for {{customer}}. Cost and margin stay internal; the customer sees only the selling charges.
pricedOptionsLede: Each option is an alternative the customer can choose. Cost comes from your carrier arrangements; the selling charges are what they see.
mixEmpty: Add a charge line with a rate to see how the price divides.
mixChartLabel: Share of the selling price by charge family

queueIntro: Every request routed to this branch, priced or waiting. The bar shows where the queue actually stands.
queuePipelineNote_unclaimed: {{count}} unclaimed · pick a segment to filter
queueFootnote: Margin and owner are internal columns and never appear in the customer view of this grid.
queueSearchWide: Search by quote, customer, route or CW1 org
queueNothing: Nothing has been quoted in your branch yet.
freeTextHint: Not on the list. It will be saved as typed.
fullRequestNoServices: No additional services were asked for.
optionNameHint: What the customer sees at the top of this option.
accessLinkIntro: We will create a one-time link for {{name}} to choose a password. Staff who sign in with Microsoft do not need one.
accessLinkReason: Why are you issuing this link
accessLinkReady: Copy this link and give it to them. We cannot show it again, but you can create a new one whenever you need to.
accessLinkEmailed: We have emailed the link to them.
